evidence.detail: has_buttons() checks show_tournament_toggle among other flags
Every view that sets tournament_only also always sets show_tournament_toggle=True and toggle_results_url together — the pattern is consistent but verbose
template gates the toggle button on show_tournament_toggle and uses toggle_results_url — both fields always set together

triage.notes: The three attributes are always set together but the refactoring approach (e.g. computing toggle_results_url centrally in View.prepare() from tournament_only, removing show_tournament_toggle) requires an owner to decide the right abstraction boundary.
